description: Deep verification in one call — zipnative's verifyZip report verbatim: eager structural validation, then every entry's CRC-32 / size / local-header agreement. `ok` is true when the structure is valid AND every verifiable entry passed AND every design-time skip ('encrypted' | 'stream-only-codec') has a local header that agrees with the central directory. This tool NEVER fails for a problem with the archive: a structural refusal lands in `error` {code: ZIP_*, message}; each row carries `skipped` with the reason its payload was not verified — a design-time skip with an agreeing local header counts in skippedCount and does not fail the archive; an entry whose method has no codec here (skipped: 'unsupported-method') or an encrypted entry whose local header contradicts the central directory is FAILED — the engine's verdict verbatim. Only caller mistakes (bad limits, bad input) are isError. `entries:'failed'` keeps the rows you act on; `verbosity:'summary'` keeps the verdict + counts. Verify before you trust: run it on any archive from an untrusted source before extract_zip.

entries.description: Which per-entry rows to return: 'all' (default), only 'failed' (ok:false, not skipped), only 'skipped', or 'none' (verdict + counts only).

fields.description: Dot-paths to keep, after verbosity (e.g. ['entryCount', 'entries.name']); unmatched ones are listed in _meta.unmatchedFields.

limits.description: Per-call override of zipnative's security bounds (CWE-400/409); absent keys keep the engine defaults (describe_engine.defaultLimits). A value above its operator ceiling is LIMIT_CEILING_EXCEEDED. Raise only for trusted input.

maxEntryCompressedSize.description: Bytes, one compressed payload fetched by the byte-range reader (access range).

maxEntries.description: Cap on returned rows (the counts always cover every entry); `entriesTruncated` flags a cut.

verbosity.description: 'summary': scalar verdict fields only (the token-frugal form).

zipBase64.description: Archive bytes, base64 (≤ 128 MiB decoded). Exclusive with zipPath.

zipPath.description: Archive path relative to the ZIPNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (container extensions: .zip .jar .docx .epub …). Exclusive with zipBase64; saves re-sending bytes between calls.

name: verify_zip

outputSchema.description: Deep verification report. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

diagnostics.description: Non-fatal engine concerns (de-duplicated by code + entry, ≤ 200; codes in describe_engine.diagnosticCodes). Empty for a clean archive.

diagnosticsTruncated.description: Present (true) when more than 200 distinct diagnostics were raised and the list was cut.

skipped.description: Why the payload was not verified (zipnative 1.1.0 adds unsupported-method, which still fails the archive).

error.description: The structural refusal when the archive could not even be opened (frozen ZIP_* code + engine message), else null.

failedCount.description: Entries that fail the archive: a CRC / size / local-header mismatch, an unknown compression method, or a design-time skip whose local header contradicts the central directory.

skippedCount.description: Entries that could not be verified by design (encrypted, stream-only codec) and whose local header agrees with the central directory.

title: Verify archive integrity (one call, never throws for archive problems)
